name: desktop-nav-grouped-header
goal: Join context controls, preserve complete resting tabs and balance mobile categories and account alignment

evidence: Visual7 rejects detached tablet/desktop-account revision controls, clipped resting tabs, orphan mobile category rows and an account chip detached from the project header.

Earlier guards checked one tab row and caption bounds but did not constrain context-group gaps, mobile row fill or account/project alignment. Extend those same12 cases and remove forced game-tab scrolling.
